content_changes: One second-level section per boss, with native item slots and localized item labels for applicable access requirements.
Moved Invoker and Wildfire out of ordinary creatures, with standalone links to the Bosses page. Removed boss images from ordinary creature sections.
Shortened large biome expansions to useful terrain or location examples, preserving detailed source evidence in the prior encounter evidence file.
Corrected End and Nether themed Enderman locations that had been mislabeled as Overworld.
Translated Chinese structure location prose, keeping official structure and mod names intact.
Kept all 142 existing structure rows, including explicit disabled or unavailable entries.
Used labeled provider artwork or habitat fallback images where no suitable structure capture was established.
gaps: All runtime registry, interaction, rendering and world generation checks remain unperformed. Explicit released item registrations are evidence of shipped code, not proof of runtime presence.
Ten boss entries have no securely identified authentic image. No substitute image is presented as their appearance.
Bosses Rise structure entry and spawner details remain at the previously evidenced system level. Exact per-boss activation, range and reset rules are not established.
Some Cataclysm companions, Illager Invasion placements and Supplementaries encounter conditions remain unresolved and retain uncertainty in player prose.
Structure locations are readable examples or terrain families, not exhaustive active biome lists. Optional integration biome names in archive tags do not prove those mods or biomes exist at runtime.
Project license metadata does not independently establish gallery image reuse permission. Permission review remains necessary before redistributing restrictive assets.
No native parser or live layout verification was run. All image references, locale parity and source conventions were checked programmatically.
